elytraplus.config.title: Elytra Plus
elytraplus.config.auto_switch_elytra.des:
Jumping in mid-air puts on the best elytra from your inventory.

When you land, your previous chest item goes back on.
elytraplus.config.auto_switch_third_pers:
Starting to fly with an elytra in first person switches to the rear third-person view.

When you land, the view goes back to first person. If you change the view yourself while flying, it is left as is.
elytraplus.config.firework_hotkey.desc:
While flying with an elytra, press the key to use a firework rocket. The rocket doesn't need to be in your hand; anywhere in your inventory works.

Assign the key under Controls → Elytra Plus.
elytraplus.config.freelook.desc:
While flying with an elytra, holding the key makes the mouse turn only the camera. You can look around without changing the direction you fly.

Assign the key under Controls → Elytra Plus.
While flying with an elytra, you can use Freelook: the mouse turns only the camera, so you can look around without changing the direction you fly.

Freelook is provided by Freelook Plus. Assign the key under Controls → Freelook Plus.

This setting is shared with Freelook Plus's Elytra setting.
elytraplus.config.freelook.freelookplus_: Freelook is turned off in Freelook Plus's settings, so it can't be used while flying, regardless of this setting. To use it, turn it on under Freelook Plus → General.
elytraplus.config.elytra_slot.desc:
While wearing an elytra, shows an elytra slot next to the hotbar.

You can check its durability there.

You can move the slots under Position below.
elytraplus.config.firework_slot.desc:
While wearing an elytra, shows a firework slot next to the elytra slot.

It shows the rocket that will be used next and how many rockets you have in total, including those in shulker boxes and bundles.

Hidden when you have no rockets.
elytraplus.config.hud_style.desc:
What the slots look like.

Hotbar: cut from the hotbar, so they match the hotbar beside them.

Inventory: inventory slots in a small light gray panel, like the inventory screen.

Both follow resource packs that change the hotbar or the inventory screen.
elytraplus.config.hud_anchor.desc:
Where the slots are placed: next to the hotbar, or in a top or bottom corner of the screen.

Works with Side.
elytraplus.config.hud_side.desc:
Which side of the hotbar or the screen the slots go on.

Main Hand Side follows your Main Hand setting, opposite the offhand slot.

Next to the hotbar on the offhand side, the slots move past the offhand slot while it is shown.
elytraplus.config.hud_orientation.desc:
Whether the slots are lined up horizontally or stacked vertically.

The elytra slot is always the one nearest the hotbar or the screen edge.
elytraplus.config.hud_offset_x.desc: Moves the slots horizontally from the position above. Positive values move them right, negative values left.
elytraplus.config.hud_offset_y.desc: Moves the slots vertically from the position above. Positive values move them down, negative values up.
